script_text: Hold your breath, Aries — the cosmos just dropped a lightning bolt in your chart! Mars, your ruling planet of fiery Fire, transits your 1st House self, squaring Saturn in your 4th House home. This clash pushes you to assert independence while home duties pull you back, creating restless tension. Meanwhile, Venus trines Jupiter in your 9th House of Adventure, promising a lucky break for travel or study. In love, expect a spontaneous spark with an adventurous soul — maybe a traveler or mentor you meet on a getaway. If coupled, plan a short trip together to reignite the flame. Career-wise, the Mars-Saturn square urges you to reorganize your home office; invest in a setup to lift your 10th House status. Financially, curb impulsive spending today and shift funds to long‑term investments that secure your future. Avoid signing contracts or big commitments until the aspect eases tomorrow. Subscribe for tomorrow's reading.
